description: Land Title Settlement Department - Ellagala, Tissamaharamaya D/S Division, Hambantota District - Cad. Map No. 830017
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels, including detailed information about parcel numbers, extents, owners' names and identities, and land title classifications. The content is focused on land ownership and property registration, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it involves land registrations, property ownership, and land title matters.
